subject: Rust Monster
picture: A rust monster in a metal-strewn dungeon storeroom. Insect body like a large beetle, four walking legs, two long antennae reaching toward a pile of simple metal tools and armor shapes. Long tail with a paddle tip. Not a dragon, not a lizard. Stone ceiling, block walls, large floor slabs, closed wooden door. Bold even black outlines on white, same look as locked I-01 and I-02.
